trap.label: estrutura
trap.wrong: She convinced me to sign the form.
trap.right: She persuaded me to sign the form.
trap.why: Português “convenceu-me a assinar” usa um só verbo; em inglês convince + that/of (crença) e persuade + to (ação).

fix.wrong: He persuaded me of his good faith.
fix.right: He convinced me of his good faith.

fix.wrong: He convinced me for his plan.
fix.right: He convinced me of his plan.

rewrite.prompt: Troque por persuade: “She convinced me to attend.”
Troque por convince: “They persuaded us that it was safe.”
rewrite.answer: They convinced us that it was safe.
She did not convince me of it.
